about: Event boxes. Six event boxes are on sale at a time and change together every rotationDays days, counted from epoch (a UTC date); rotation n shows set n modulo the number of sets, so the order below is the schedule. Each event box has the slot's odds of boxes.json (event1 to event6) and its own exclusive epic and legendary items, which no other box, the shelf or the pass ever gives. Common and rare drops come from the usual box pool. art: the set's box picture (box art, shared by its six boxes); item art follows the cosmetics rule. Item ids, titles and art names must stay unique.
